## Failed main-run jobs and local repair observations

`verify` failed because actionlint did not know the custom `zenith-operated` runner label. The dirty candidate adds `.github/actionlint.yaml` with that label. Official actionlint 1.7.12 then passed all seven workflow files used by CI. The remote e2f job remains failed.

`hosted` failed one local callback-cookie check in the remote job. A local root candidate later reported 22 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. That receipt is candidate-only.

`go` ran the required race command with exit 0, but the strict gate rejected its sanitized report: 1,074 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped. The sanitized Go artifact does not include the four skipped identities, so they remain unidentified. No skip waiver was added.

`docker` failed in remote CI because the build could not find a ledger file. A native Linux ARM64 successor build later exited 0 and reported minimum free disk of 402,839,183,360 bytes against a 23,622,320,128-byte floor. This is a local build-only receipt and does not turn the remote Docker job green or prove product/service readiness.

`recovery` failed remotely with 9 passed, 1 failed, 0 skipped: the Temporal workflow was still `RUNNING` after the query-form terminate command returned. A local successor run later reported 10 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Final current-source verification remains pending.

`agent` failed remotely: 11 of 13 checks passed; two approval submissions returned HTTP 403, and no credential was issued. The local root candidate later reported 40 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped and removed its owned data. This result is candidate-only.

## Local candidate checks

The initial combined CI, release, and official conformance run reported 1,916 passed, 14 failed, and 11 gated skips. All 14 failures were in `tests/ci/evidence-sanitizer.test.ts`; they were repaired by copying the complete manifest helper dependency chain into the fixture and restoring exact equality against canonical external acceptance. A subsequent combined contract run reported 1,961 passed, 0 failed, and 11 gated skips (1,972 total) before the later filesystem identity serialization delta.

Other observed candidate receipts include 138 targeted tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; four SYS1 contract suites repeated twice with 696 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; a full typecheck using a 5,120 MiB heap with no diagnostics; 0 security-audit findings; lint with 0 errors and 3 pre-existing vendor warnings; actionlint with 0 findings across all seven CI workflow files; generated policy/OPA at 219 passed and 0 failed using WASM hash `708b2e07eff3762498bbbf8f99c2574717dcf7a8346acf788e3d40e3bce539e1`; and Gimbal verification passed. SYS1 evidence is contract-only and is not actual privileged execution.

An earlier scoped compiler run and the native ARM64 build passed. The initial typecheck of the new fixture found optional `getuid` and null-literal type errors; those were fixed, and a later full typecheck passed. Review also required `f_fsid` string serialization for 64-bit compatibility, which is now applied. Final independent Sol review of that delta remains pending, so these candidate checks do not establish final acceptance.
